paragraphs.text: Students must attend at least 80 per cent of classes to receive a certificate. If you miss three classes in a row without telling your tutor, your place may be given to someone on the waiting list.

Course fees are refunded in full if you withdraw before the second class, and half the fee is refunded up to the fourth. Materials are not refundable once opened. Parking permits are issued at the office in week one.

items.quote: Students must attend at least 80 per cent of classes to receive a certificate
items.prompt: A certificate requires attendance at every class.

explanation.en: 80 per cent is needed, not every class → FALSE.
explanation.ru: Нужно 80 %, а не все занятия → FALSE.

items.quote: your place may be given to someone on the waiting list
items.prompt: Missing classes without warning may cost you your place.

explanation.en: The place may be given to someone on the waiting list → TRUE.
explanation.kk: Орынды кезектегі адамға беруі мүмкін → TRUE.
explanation.ru: Место могут отдать из списка ожидания → TRUE.

items.quote: half the fee is refunded up to the fourth
items.prompt: A student who leaves after the third class gets half the fee back.

explanation.en: Half is refunded up to the fourth class → TRUE.
explanation.kk: Төртінші сабаққа дейін жартысы қайтарылады → TRUE.
explanation.ru: Половина возвращается вплоть до четвёртого занятия → TRUE.

items.quote: Parking permits are issued at the office in week one

explanation.en: Nothing is said about the price of a permit → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.kk: Рұқсаттаманың бағасы туралы ештеңе жоқ → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.ru: О цене пропуска ничего не сказано → NOT GIVEN.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–4. Do the following statements agree with the information in the text? Write TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN.
